jobs.title: Data & AI Engineer (Athens, Greece)
jobs.description:

In this role you will advise our clients during the conception, planning and implementation of data & AI solutions. Based in our consulting hub in Athens, you will work with your project team to provide our clients the high quality and reliability we are known for.

  • Analyzing requirements and designing tailored data solutions
  • Contributing to various project areas, which may include cloud engineering, infrastructure, data engineering (ETL), data science, and generative AI applications
  • Presenting results and insights to stakeholders and management
  • Occasionally traveling to Switzerland and internationally to meet clients and collaborate with our team at headquarters in Zurich

  • An uncomplicated and low noise environment that enables to focus on what matters most.
